Cenva Labs | Senior SWE / Technical Lead | Remote (US, West Coast/Central hours) | $130K-$150K

Healthcare-focused engineering firm in LA. We build and maintain the technical infrastructure for a concierge primary care practice serving employer groups across multiple states.

Looking for a player-coach: hands-on in TypeScript/Node.js + React + AWS (Lambda, ECS, RDS, SST, PostgreSQL) every day, while mentoring a junior engineer and owning architecture decisions. Healthcare integrations are messy (EHR systems, labs, SFTP file drops, claims data) - if you've done this kind of work, you know.

Healthcare/HIPAA experience strongly preferred. This is a path to running the technical operation, not a staff augmentation gig. Small team, real ownership, no bureaucracy.

Paid take-home assessment (no LeetCode). We compensate you for your time regardless of outcome.

Health/dental/vision (50% covered), 401(k), unlimited PTO.

Apply at: https://www.cenvalabs.com/careers/senior-software-engineer-t...
